name: Destructive PDF redactor & blackout tool
description: Redacting sensitive information from legal filings, government FOIA requests, and corporate contracts requires true destructive removal of underlying data. A notorious failure mode in digital redaction involves placing black rectangles over sensitive text without deleting the underlying text stream—allowing anyone to select, copy, or search the hidden Social Security Numbers, names, or financial figures underneath. PrivacyFold's Destructive PDF Redactor permanently removes both the visual elements and the underlying content stream objects, vector paths, and metadata from the document structure. Running 100% locally in your browser, it ensures that classified and private information is mathematically eradicated before the document ever leaves your workstation.

seo.aeoSummary: PrivacyFold's Destructive PDF Redactor permanently burns blackouts into document content streams and scrubs underlying text, vector objects, and metadata in local RAM, eliminating data leaks with zero server transmission.

faqs.question: Can someone copy and paste the text underneath the black boxes in the output PDF?
faqs.answer: No. Unlike superficial annotation tools that merely place a black rectangle annotation on top, PrivacyFold destructively removes the text glyphs, font references, and string literals from the PDF content stream. The text no longer exists in the file.

faqs.question: Does this tool satisfy legal standards for court filings and FOIA compliance?
faqs.answer: Yes. It adheres to federal court redaction rules (such as US Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 5.2) and FOIA guidelines by completely purging designated characters from both the display layer and search indexing layer.

faqs.question: Are OCR text layers and hidden text stripped as well?
faqs.answer: Yes. Any invisible OCR text layer within the specified redaction coordinates is excised from the document object hierarchy.

faqs.question: Is my document uploaded to any cloud server during redaction?
faqs.answer: No. The entire rendering, redaction, and file re-generation pipeline executes inside your browser tab via WebAssembly and Canvas APIs. Zero bytes are uploaded.

faqs.question: Does redaction alter the rest of the document formatting or quality?
faqs.answer: No. Non-redacted text, vector graphics, and layout structures remain completely crisp and uncompressed.

faqs.question: Can I redact multiple pages in a single document?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can navigate through multi-page contracts, apply redaction marks across any number of pages, and burn them all in a single pass.

steps: Open your PDF document in the secure client-side viewer.
Use the redaction cursor to draw blackout boxes over sensitive names, account numbers, or text paragraphs.
Optionally enable automated PII pattern matching to flag SSNs, credit card numbers, and email addresses.
Preview the redactions and select "Apply Destructive Redaction".
Download the permanently sanitized document with verified zero underlying text leakage.

settingsExplained.name: Redaction Mark Style
settingsExplained.description: Choose between solid black fill (standard legal blackout) or cross-hatch outline with exemption codes (FOIA style).
settingsExplained.example: Use solid black for court filings and legal NDAs.

settingsExplained.name: Metadata Purge
settingsExplained.description: Automatically strips author names, software creation timestamps, and revision histories that could reveal who drafted the document.
settingsExplained.example: Prevents metadata from revealing internal corporate author identities.

settingsExplained.name: Exemption Label (Optional)
settingsExplained.description: Prints statutory FOIA or privacy exemption codes (e.g. "(b)(6) Personal Privacy") over the blackout area.
settingsExplained.example: Helpful for government transparency and public records responses.

whatToExpect.results: A sanitized PDF document where redacted regions cannot be selected, searched, or extracted by any PDF inspection tool.
whatToExpect.limits: Supports PDF documents up to 100 pages per session.
whatToExpect.benchmarks: Applies and burns redactions at ~35ms per page in WebAssembly RAM.

privacyProof.howItWorks: Rewrites the PDF page content stream by removing glyph drawing operators (Tj / TJ) within the target bounding boxes and burning a filled path operator.
verificationSteps: Redact a sample sentence with the tool and download the output.
Open the output in Acrobat, Chrome, or Preview.
Attempt to highlight or copy text over the black box: confirm no text is selectable or searchable.
Inspect DevTools Network tab to confirm 0 network requests occurred.
